placements.why: The database migration decision is an infrastructure architecture decision — a new organizational category nothing existing covers, since strata starts empty for this repo.
placements.title: Infrastructure platform decisions
placements.theme: The organization's data and analytics infrastructure is being reshaped to meet performance and cost targets through platform migration.

placements.title: Analytics pipeline migrates from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB
placements.theme: The analytics pipeline's database platform shifts to QuantumDB to achieve order-of-magnitude query performance gains and reduce licensing costs.
placements.why: All four segments cohere around the database migration decision: src-1 asserts it with performance and cost justification, src-2 through src-4 decompose the same decision into target, performance gain, and timeline. This is a directional statement of infrastructure change that future envelopes may continue to feed — it passes the narrative grain test as a subject, not a fact.
